title: TechVista 2026 - Annual Tech Fest
description: The flagship national level technical festival of CHARUSAT featuring hackathons, coding marathons, robotics, and paper presentations.

title: AI & Deep Learning National Workshop
description: Hands-on 3-day workshop covering Neural Networks, Computer Vision, PyTorch, and LLM deployment techniques.

title: Cognizance 2026 Coding Challenge
description: Competitive programming tournament testing data structures, algorithms, and dynamic programming problem solving.

title: Spoural 2026 Sports League
description: Inter-departmental athletics, cricket, football, volleyball, and badminton tournament for all institutes.

title: Cultural Gala Night & Alumni Meet
description: A vibrant evening featuring music performances, traditional garba, drama, fashion show, and distinguished alumni networking.

title: Web Development Frameworks Hackathon
description: 24-hour hackathon focused on building full-stack web portals using HTML5, CSS3, JS, PHP, and MySQL.

title: Cybersecurity & Ethical Hacking Seminar
description: Industry experts from Red Hat & ISO security auditors discuss penetration testing, network defense, and zero trust security.

title: Cloud Computing & AWS Certification Bootcamp
description: Comprehensive prep course for AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner and Solutions Architect certifications.

title: Career Expo & Corporate Placement Drive
description: Top MNCs visit campus for recruitment drives, resume reviews, mock technical interviews, and HR sessions.

title: Robotics & IoT Smart Hardware Expo
description: Showcase of embedded systems, Arduino/Raspberry Pi smart automation projects, and drone demonstrations.

title: Entrepreneurship & Startup Pitch Summit
description: Student entrepreneurs pitch innovative business models to angel investors and seed fund evaluators.

title: Blood Donation & Health Checkup Camp
description: Annual NSS health drive in collaboration with Indian Red Cross Society providing free health checkups and blood donation.

title: Open Source Code Camp & Git Masterclass
description: Learn version control, Git workflow, pull request guidelines, and open source contribution for Hacktoberfest.

title: Design Thinking & UI/UX Design Sprint
description: Learn Figma wireframing, component design systems, accessibility testing, and user-centric prototyping.

title: Environmental Sustainability & Tree Plantation Drive
description: Eco-friendly campus initiative aimed at planting 1000 saplings across the university premises.
